positives: Mature recognizable adult silhouette; integrated cargo pockets/cuffs/high-tops, with no obvious clothing holes or detached layers.

positives: Eyes, brows, mouth and beard are readable; native daylight removes most pale CPU-studio washout.

Triangular neck and shoulder planes read as coarse mesh/shading facets.

images.comparison_to_first_window: Subtle shoulder-highlight improvement without losing eyes/beard. Broad neck facets, pale jagged collar and chunky shiny curls persist.

defects: Open/coarse hand silhouette and angular upper-arm folds persist.

comparison.shoulders: Modest gain: highlight continuity has fewer conspicuous flat patches. Neck facets/irregular collar geometry remain.
comparison.face: Small visible change. Eyes, brows, beard and adult identity stay readable; no clear new gross normal-map artifact.
comparison.poses: Integrated cargos/cuffs/shoes and general silhouettes remain coherent in Idle/Walk/Run/Airborne/Landing. Stiff hands and pinched angular airborne shoulders persist.
comparison.style: Comic contours remain legible, with unchanged broad indigo cast and busy scene-wide tree/ground edge noise. The material normal change does not add authored graphic-novel linework.

limits: No GPU, Unreal, paid provider or service launched by reviewer.
Stills do not prove fluidity, full-cycle foot contact, transition quality, input delivery or frame rate.
Generated pilot has24body bones and static face/fingers; no claimed facial/finger acting.
Old pilot comparison uses retained CPU front view, not a matching native capture in this render window.
Native screenshots provide no dedicated hand close-up; five-digit count is supported by retained CPU side views, not certified from tiny native hand pixels.
Clear-pitch fixture and deliberate frontal/face cameras do not establish readability in crowds, HUD-heavy play or the default camera.
No matching old-pilot native matrix in this render window; old-model comparison is limited to CPU evidence.
Qualitative A/B only: native animation phases/camera angles differ slightly between runs.
Geometry-only defects cannot be accepted as fixed by this material change. No continuous video reviewed in this still report.
recommendation: Retain full mapped normal for this bounded generated-v1 draft; do not claim collar/neck/hand/whole-graphics or motion completion. Hold for geometry fix and final continuous-motion evidence.
